SDN.note: Names Zain Sudan's main Jabra data centre and Sudani's temporary Port Sudan one, but neither is stated to rent to others.
No outage count; only generators stopped at one data centre.
No share of people using the internet given.
Sudani's temporary data centre is the operator's own and not stated to be for hire.
No public body's backup site; a minister only urges operators to build disaster recovery centres.
The blackout is blamed on the RSF, a non-government group, with no order by government, regulator or security forces stated.
Says many Sudanese resorted to Starlink, but no licence or sale is stated.
